meta.name: Selemene Engine — Aleph Launch Tasks
meta.description: Post-MVP improvement plan: bug fixes, cleanup, refactoring, docs, and deploy verification. Filtered from Grok's 55-task plan against actual codebase state.
filtered_out: Grok Task 33 (cargo-audit in CI) — already done in MVP-04
Redis L2 cache tasks — already done in MVP-05/MVP-08
Test stability (SIGTRAP cleanup) — already done in MVP-07
OpenAPI updates — already done in MVP-18
Load test baseline — already done in MVP-21
Secret scanning — already done in MVP-04
Grok Task 14 (merge biofield to experimental) — biofield is 1.7K+ LOC, NOT a stub
Grok Task 26 (merge face-reading to experimental) — face-reading is 1.7K+ LOC, NOT a stub
Grok Task 30 (accuracy tests for experimental crate) — no experimental crate needed
Grok Task 32 (merge similar handlers in vedic-api) — too vague, needs separate assessment
vitest benchmark references — ts-engines uses Bun, not vitest

tasks.title: Fix vimshottari 120-year cycle total (117.375 vs 120)
tasks.description: Vimshottari dasha period durations sum to 117.375 years instead of the canonical 120. Investigate rounding/truncation in period calculations and fix to match traditional values.

tasks.title: Fix vimshottari antardasha date continuity (4-day gap)
tasks.description: Antardasha sub-periods have a 4-day gap between consecutive periods. End date of one period should equal start date of the next. Fix date boundary calculations.

tasks.title: Fix TCM element relationships mapping (Metal vs Water)
tasks.description: TCM element relationship mapping returns incorrect controlling/generating cycle elements. Verify against Wu Xing (Five Elements) canonical relationships.

tasks.title: Fix TCM analysis from birth profile (Earth vs Fire)
tasks.description: TCM analysis derived from birth profile assigns incorrect primary element (Earth instead of Fire for certain birth data). Trace element derivation logic and fix mapping.

tasks.title: Fix engine-human-design SIGSEGV on multi-threaded test cleanup
tasks.description: Human Design engine tests SIGSEGV during cleanup in multi-threaded test execution. Likely related to shared static data or unsafe FFI teardown. Investigate with RUST_BACKTRACE=full and thread sanitizer.

tasks.title: Cargo workspace audit — list all crates, tag stubs vs active
tasks.description: Audit all workspace members. Tag each as: active (>500 LOC, tests), stub (<300 LOC, minimal), or support (shared types/utils). Map dependency graph from Cargo.lock. Actual stubs: noesis-witness (34 LOC), noesis-western-api (270 LOC), noesis-core (269 LOC). NOT stubs: biofield, face-reading (1.7K+ LOC each).

tasks.title: Run cargo-udeps for dead code scan
tasks.description: Install and run cargo-udeps --workspace to identify unused dependencies across all crates. Document findings for Phase 2 cleanup.

tasks.title: Run benchmark baselines for all engines
tasks.description: Execute all benchmarks in benches/ directory (hd_performance.rs, vim_performance.rs, etc.). Record baseline numbers for comparison in Phase 5.

tasks.title: Test coverage gap analysis across all crates
tasks.description: Run cargo-tarpaulin or llvm-cov to measure test coverage per crate. Identify crates below 60% coverage. Prioritize gaps for Phase 3 testing work.

tasks.title: Identify prune candidates (legacy/, archive/, deprecated scripts)
tasks.description: Audit legacy/, archive/root-binary-prototype/, and scripts/ for deletion candidates. List each file with rationale (superseded, unused, deprecated). Output: prune-candidates.md.

tasks.title: Doc gap analysis — .context/ vs actual codebase
tasks.description: Compare .context/ documentation against actual codebase structure. Identify stale docs, missing coverage for new engines/workflows, and outdated architecture descriptions.

tasks.title: Archive legacy/ directory
tasks.description: Move legacy/ contents to a git tag or archive branch. Remove from main working tree. Verify no active code references legacy/ paths.

tasks.title: Archive root-binary-prototype directory
tasks.description: Move archive/root-binary-prototype/ out of main tree. This is a historical prototype that's been superseded by the workspace binary setup.

tasks.title: Clean .gitkeep files in data/
tasks.description: Remove .gitkeep placeholder files from data/ subdirectories that now contain actual data files. Verify git still tracks the directories.

tasks.title: Evaluate noesis-witness stub (34 LOC) for absorption into noesis-core
tasks.description: noesis-witness is 34 LOC — a true stub. Evaluate if its types/traits should merge into noesis-core or remain as a future expansion point. If merging: update all Cargo.toml references, move types, remove crate.

tasks.title: Evaluate noesis-western-api stub (270 LOC) for consolidation
tasks.description: noesis-western-api is 270 LOC — minimal stub for Western astrology API. Evaluate: keep as placeholder for future Western astrology support, or absorb into noesis-vedic-api as a submodule. Decision depends on roadmap intent.

tasks.title: Prune deprecated scripts
tasks.description: Remove or archive deprecated scripts: test_gene_keys_frequency.sh, verify_phase3.sh, and any others identified in ALEPH-10 that are superseded by CI workflows or newer scripts.

tasks.title: Run cargo fmt --all for consistency
tasks.description: Run cargo fmt --all across the entire workspace. Commit formatting changes as a standalone commit for clean git blame.

tasks.title: Lint TS engines (bun run lint in ts-engines/)
tasks.description: Run bun run lint in ts-engines/ directory. Fix lint errors and warnings. Note: ts-engines uses Bun, not vitest.

tasks.title: Prune old .claude/ agent artifacts
tasks.description: Clean up outdated agent summary files (AGENT_XX_COMPLETION_SUMMARY.md) and old task management artifacts in .claude/ that are no longer relevant post-MVP.

tasks.title: Remove unused symlinks in legacy/
tasks.description: Identify and remove broken or unused symlinks in legacy/ directory before archiving.

tasks.title: Clean duplicate/unused data files
tasks.description: Audit data/ directory for duplicate JSON files or unused data files that are not referenced by any engine. Remove after confirming no imports/references.

tasks.title: Audit k8s/ for redundant YAML manifests
tasks.description: Review k8s/ directory for redundant or unused Kubernetes manifests (e.g., postgres-replication.yml if not needed, unused service definitions). Remove or consolidate.

tasks.title: Phase 2 summary — cargo check + file count before/after
tasks.description: After all Phase 2 tasks complete: run cargo check --workspace, document file count reduction (before vs after), verify no compilation errors introduced. Create phase-2-summary.md.

tasks.title: Add fuzz tests for ephemeris.rs (cargo-fuzz)
tasks.description: Add cargo-fuzz targets for ephemeris calculation functions. Focus on edge cases: extreme dates, boundary julian day numbers, leap second transitions.

tasks.title: Optimize vimshottari dasha profiling
tasks.description: Profile vim_performance.rs benchmarks. Identify hot paths in dasha period calculations. Apply naive_then_optimize: ensure correctness first (ALEPH-01/02 fixes), then optimize critical paths.

tasks.title: Integrate TCM consistency in vedic-clock engine
tasks.description: After TCM fixes (ALEPH-03/04), ensure vedic-clock engine consistently uses corrected TCM element mappings. Update models.rs and any TCM-related calculations in the vedic-clock engine.

tasks.title: Add L3 disk cache metrics to noesis-cache tests
tasks.description: Extend noesis-cache test suite with L3 disk cache metric collection. Verify cache hit/miss ratios, eviction behavior, and disk I/O overhead under test load.

tasks.title: Optimize workflow synthesis parallelism (tokio tasks)
tasks.description: Refactor birth_blueprint.rs and workflow synthesizers to use tokio::spawn for parallel engine execution where engines are independent. Measure latency improvement vs sequential execution.

tasks.title: Add performance benchmarks for TS engines (Bun-native)
tasks.description: Create Bun-native performance benchmarks for TS engines (numerology, biorhythm). Use Bun's built-in bench capabilities, NOT vitest. Establish baseline p95 latencies.

tasks.title: Extend chaos testing to cover Redis failures
tasks.description: Extend run-chaos-tests.sh to simulate Redis connection failures, timeouts, and OOM conditions. Verify graceful degradation to L1 in-memory cache.

tasks.title: Add security test variants (auth_bypass expansion)
tasks.description: Expand auth_bypass test suite with additional attack vectors: expired tokens, malformed JWTs, role escalation attempts, missing auth headers on protected endpoints.

tasks.title: Add dotenv-linter for env validation in CI
tasks.description: Add dotenv-linter to CI workflow to validate .env.example and catch env var issues (missing quotes, duplicate keys, invalid syntax) before deploy.

tasks.title: Create unified test runner script (cargo test + bun test)
tasks.description: Create a root-level test.sh that runs both cargo test --workspace and bun test in ts-engines/. Standardize exit codes and output formatting. Use in CI.

tasks.title: Extend k6 load tests to cover TS engines
tasks.description: Add k6 load test scenarios for TS engine endpoints (numerology, biorhythm). Verify p95 latency under concurrent load. Compare against Rust engine baselines.

tasks.title: Phase 3 summary — full test suite + coverage delta
tasks.description: After all Phase 3 tasks complete: run full test suite, measure coverage delta vs ALEPH-09 baseline, document performance improvements and new test counts. Create phase-3-summary.md.

tasks.title: Update CODEBASE_INDEX.md with post-cleanup structure
tasks.description: Rewrite CODEBASE_INDEX.md to reflect post-Phase-2 codebase structure. Remove references to archived/deleted directories. Add new crates or restructured paths.

tasks.title: Integrate cargo-udeps as dead code hygiene in CI
tasks.description: Add cargo-udeps to CI workflow as a non-blocking check. Report unused dependencies in CI output. Use findings from ALEPH-07 as baseline.

tasks.title: TODO resolution sweep (grep TODOs, resolve or track)
tasks.description: Grep all TODO/FIXME/HACK comments across workspace. For each: resolve if trivial, create a tracked issue if non-trivial, or document as intentional with explanation.

tasks.title: Run cargo clippy --fix pass
tasks.description: Run cargo clippy --fix --workspace to auto-fix lint warnings. Review changes before committing. Address the 67 pre-existing warnings in noesis-vedic-api.

tasks.title: Enhance API_QUICKSTART.md with TS engine examples
tasks.description: Add TS engine endpoint examples (numerology, biorhythm) to API_QUICKSTART.md. Include curl examples, expected responses, and error cases.

tasks.title: Update RELEASE_NOTES.md with Aleph upgrade summaries
tasks.description: Add Aleph Launch release notes covering: P0 bug fixes, cleanup metrics, refactoring improvements, and new test coverage. Include before/after metrics.

tasks.title: Create Binary Guide section in README.md
tasks.description: Add a Binary Guide section to README.md explaining: noesis-server binary, build instructions, runtime configuration, Docker usage, and development vs production modes.

tasks.title: Generate mdBook from .context/ documentation
tasks.description: Set up mdBook to compile .context/ markdown files into a navigable documentation site. Configure SUMMARY.md, book.toml, and add CI step to build docs on push.

tasks.title: Docker-compose full stack verification
tasks.description: Run docker-compose up with all services (noesis-server, PostgreSQL, Redis). Test all endpoint categories: health, auth, engine, workflow. Verify inter-service connectivity.

tasks.title: CI workflow trigger + artifact verification
tasks.description: Trigger full CI workflow on final Aleph branch. Verify: all tests pass, Docker image builds, artifacts are published, no warnings in security scans.

tasks.title: Performance re-baseline vs Phase 1 benchmarks
tasks.description: Re-run all benchmarks from ALEPH-08. Compare against Phase 1 baselines. Document improvements/regressions. Target: no regression >5%, improvements in vimshottari and synthesis paths.

tasks.title: Staging deploy to Railway + 24h monitoring
tasks.description: Deploy Aleph release to Railway staging. Monitor for 24 hours: health endpoint uptime, error rates in Sentry, response latencies, memory/CPU usage. Document findings.

tasks.title: Final retrospective with metrics
tasks.description: Write aleph-retrospective.md with metrics: crate count delta, file count delta, test coverage delta, benchmark performance delta, lines of dead code removed, TODO count resolved. Include lessons learned.

tasks.title: Phase 5 signoff — final cargo check + test suite green
tasks.description: Final verification gate: cargo check --workspace clean, cargo test --workspace all pass, bun test in ts-engines/ all pass, cargo clippy --workspace no errors. Signoff for production deploy.
